# @humanities/bailly-search-key (provisional copy)

Verbatim copy of `src/` of [`@humanities/bailly-search-key` 0.2.0](https://github.com/defense-humanites/bailly-search-key)
(AGPL-3.0-or-later, cf. `LICENSE`), which is only published on JSR for now.

**To be removed** once the package is published on npm: replace the import in
`src/searchKey.ts` by `@humanities/bailly-search-key` and delete this directory. Do
not edit these files here: any change belongs to the package, which the data
converter uses too (the search keys of the headwords and of the queries must be
computed by the same code).
